links.outcome: Change in LLM urgency triage across patient personae differing in communication style and emotion
links.effect: Communication style significantly altered triage outcomes across five patient personae and four LLMs (1,164 clinician-graded cases); specific effect sizes not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We found that communication style can significantly alter triage outcomes.

unlisted_practices: Using a patient simulator that separately models clinical content, emotional state, conversational strategy and communication style to evaluate health chatbots
Analysing real patient-chatbot conversations to ground evaluation personas
Turing-style human-grader testing of simulator realism

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM triage performance across diverse simulated patient communication styles and personas, highlighting performance variability and risks without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
